specials: When making a shooting attack, any roll of double 1s to hit will cause the Warp Lightning Cannon unit to become confused. This includes stand and shoot attacks.
skaven:warp-lightning-cannon.notes: The Warp Lightning Cannon follows the rules for Elven Bolt Throwers as per page 75 of the rulebook, but they can move up to 20cm. A half pace move is 10cm.
